description:
Priority: P0 (reproducibility). File: rust-toolchain.toml (new). Reference: keystore/aviary/metricstore (byte-identical).

Problem: No toolchain pin, so builds float on whatever is installed and coverage tooling has no guaranteed llvm-tools-preview.

Change: Create verbatim from a sibling:
  [toolchain]
  channel = "1.96.0"
  components = ["rust-analyzer", "rust-src", "llvm-tools-preview"]
  profile = "default"

Acceptance: File exists at repo root; cargo --version resolves to 1.96.0; pinned channel (1.96.0) >= declared rust-version = "1.92" MSRV in Cargo.toml.
title: [TPL-002] Pin the toolchain with rust-toolchain.toml
